title: Fix the Missing Self Parameter
description: The program should define a class with a method that greets using the object's name. Fix the bug.
actualProblem: Instance methods must accept self as their first parameter to receive the calling object. greet() is missing it, so calling p.greet() passes p as an unexpected extra argument, raising a TypeError.
explanation: When you call an object's method with p.greet(), Python automatically passes p in as the first argument. The method definition must include a matching parameter (conventionally named self) to receive it.
